# awscc_kendra_query_suggestions_block_list (Resource)

A block list used for query suggestions for an Amazon Kendra index. A block list contains words or phrases that should not appear as query suggestions.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `index_id` (String) The identifier of the index for the block list.
- `name` (String) The name of the block list.
- `role_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of an IAM role with permission to access the S3 bucket that contains the block list text file.
- `source_s3_path` (Attributes) Information required to find a specific file in an Amazon S3 bucket. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--source_s3_path))

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description for the block list.
- `tags` (Attributes List) A list of key-value pairs that identify or categorize the block list. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the query suggestions block list.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `query_suggestions_block_list_id` (String) The identifier of the block list.

<a id="nestedatt--source_s3_path"></a>
### Nested Schema for `source_s3_path`

Required:

- `bucket` (String) The name of the S3 bucket that contains the file.
- `key` (String) The name of the file.


<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String) The key for the tag.
- `value` (String) The value associated with the tag.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_kendra_query_suggestions_block_list.example
  identity = {
    arn = "arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the query suggestions block list

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_kendra_query_suggestions_block_list.example
  id = "arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:
